reported.title: Toggles on release instead of press
reported.description: risingEdge() fires on LOW-to-HIGH, which is the release edge of an active-LOW key, so the LED toggles on release rather than on press.

reported.title: No debounce/settle window
reported.description: The sketch reads the key every loop with no 40 ms settle window, so contact bounce on press and release produces multiple toggles.

reported.title: No hysteresis on key state
reported.description: There is no stable-state tracking, so a noisy or marginal key level can toggle the LED repeatedly instead of requiring a settled edge.

judge_input.spec:
- Panel key on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); status LED on D13.
- Each settled press toggles D13 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Use a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge (HIGH-to-LOW after settle).
- Print `panel led=<0|1> edges=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (unpressed) key reads HIGH.
